notes: Each point uses fresh daemon processes and namespaces. Only SESSION_COOKIE differs between before variants.
Goodput uses receiver SIGUSR1 sample deltas and excludes drain; missing and reordering use final unique counts.
CPU process and thread deltas use before/sent snapshots; drop counters include drain.
No builds or other owned tests ran during measurements. CPU placement matches previous 60-second controls.
Receiver CPU above 90% limits throughput attribution; these are diagnostic comparisons, not passed performance gates.
